answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The tundra of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the oasis is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
